name: Lee University
academic_ranking: Private Christian university affiliated with the Church of God (Cleveland, TN). Founded 1918; university status since 1997. Ranked #31 of 123 in its regional category by U.S. News & World Report. ~3,680 students (fall 2023). Six academic divisions including Colleges of Arts & Sciences and Education and Schools of Business, Music, Nursing, and Theology & Ministry. Motto: 'Where Christ is King.'
financial_aid: Tuition is charged per credit hour ($1,060/credit hour for 2026-2027; $1,005 for 2025-2026); full-time load is 12-16 hours. Annual tuition figure of ~$31,800 is an estimate based on 30 credit hours/year at the 2026-2027 rate. Aid includes federal Pell/SEOG/TEACH grants, Work-Study, and Direct/PLUS loans; veteran benefits (Post-9/11 GI Bill, Yellow Ribbon); and numerous institutional/endowed scholarships (e.g., Poiema, Asian Pacific, Lettie Pate Whitehead, Hicks Scholars) plus a Family Tuition Discount. FAFSA Title IV code 003500; priority deadline Feb 1.
facilities_notes: Lee softball is part of the Lee University Flames athletics program in Cleveland, TN. Softball-specific facility details could not be verified from a live page (facility page returned a server error during research 2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Gulf South Conference. Part of the Lee University Flames, which field 18 varsity sports at the D2 level.
notes: Data fetched live from leeuflames.com softball coaches and roster pages and leeuniversity.edu cost/aid page on 2026-07. Roster size (21) confirmed from the 2026 softball roster page. Conference (Gulf South) confirmed from roster page. Tuition is per-credit-hour; annual value is an estimate (see financial_aid). No individual coach Twitter/X handles are listed on the staff directory (team account is @LeeUSoftball). Scholarship count not publicly listed.
